description: CentrePlan Downtown Bike Lanes is a dataset listed in City of Winnipeg open data portal (data.winnipeg.ca), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Winnipeg. 2025 got a boost as a result of transit being relocated off Graham and Vaughan. As part of the interim activation of those streets, the space formerly reserved for buses has been reallocated to pedestrians and cyclists. Source: City of Winnipeg Public Works Goal: Expand the cycling network. Coverage: Winnipeg. The portal files it under the category Transportation. Its tags are cycling, downtown, transportation. The table has 2 columns. The portal shows 2026-05-29 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Canada Open Government Licence. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-winnipeg-ca-portal.
